name: Admin Diagnostic Email Composer
description: Admin sends a follow-up branded email from the Correos tab of the diagnostic edit page. Composer includes recipient, subject, draggable body sections (per-section Markdown toggle), footer, optional attachments, and a server-rendered preview of the real branded template (POST /api/emails/preview/). NDA branch: checking 'Adjuntar acuerdo de confidencialidad' appends attach_confidentiality:1 to the FormData and the backend generates and attaches the confidentiality PDF. History lists previous sends (sections stored as legacy strings or {text, markdown} objects).
